description: Shots 9-16 of the full-length MarmotCroons. Split from a single sixteen-shot workflow because that one could not finish. Every completed step is retained as a previous_result for later steps to reference - about 460 MB for a 124-frame 960x544 shot - and the H3 pipeline is already ~51 GB resident, so RSS crept from 51.5 GB after load to 57 GB by the thirteenth shot and the kernel killed the run on the fourteenth with 3.3 GB left. Eight shots per run holds the peak around 55 GB. Each part writes its shots to outputs/ as it goes; MarmotCroonsStitch.json joins all sixteen and lays the song over the finished edit. Run it as 'python -m dw.run local_inputs/MarmotCroonsFullB.json -o local_inputs/shots' so the shots land where MarmotCroonsStitch.json expects them.
